hero.title: Know Your Food.
hero.subtitle: We are here to create a healthier, aware and stronger tomorrow for you and the next generations.

purpose.title: Better Awareness. Better Choices. Better Life.
purpose.description1: Our purpose is simple yet powerful - to help everyone make informed food choices through clear, reliable and easy-to-understand information.
purpose.description2: We believe that the right knowledge about food can prevent disease, improve well-being and add years to life. By knowing what we eat and how it affects our body, we can build a healthier today and a disease-free tomorrow.
purpose.highlight: Everyone deserves to be healthy, live longer and enjoy life to the fullest. Be aware. Eat smart. Live long. Live healthy.

features.title: Know Your Food
features.description: Discover the benefits, nutrition, risks and best ways to eat every food.

features.title: Protect Your Health
features.description: Good food choices today can help prevent many health problems tomorrow.

features.title: Care for Future Generations
features.description: We create awareness so that our children and their future can live healthier and happier.

mission.title: To empower everyone with the right food knowledge for a healthier life.
mission.description: We provide accurate, research-based and easy-to-understand information on groceries, fruits, vegetables, nuts, seeds, non-vegetarian foods and more – to help you make better choices for you and your family.

vision.title: A world where every individual lives a long, healthy and disease-free life.
vision.description: We dream of a future where good health is everyone's right. Through awareness and education, we aim to build a community that chooses health, prevents illness and lives life to the fullest.

items.title: Trust & Transparency

items.title: Health First

items.title: Simplicity

items.title: Compassion
items.description: We care for you, your family and future generations.
